_comment: Cards that exist only for the Class tests (tests/unit/keywords/test_class_levels.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_class` puts one ability of every kind the level gate has to reach on one ladder: a level-1 anthem that is always there, a level-2 trigger, a level-2 player-wide static (read off the printed face by `player_statics`), a level-2 `lose_all_abilities` (read off the printed face by `_ability_statics`), a level-3 anthem and a level-3 activated ability. The level lines sit between them in printed order, so a gate that dropped seats instead of holding them would renumber the level-3 line.
